title: Signal reset completion with Robotiq
goal: For every single-arm Release reset, close the Robotiq before arm reset and open it afterward, using the completed open action as the operator-visible reset-complete signal.
doneWhen: All Release reset paths invoked by Y and A+X use close → reset_ee_pose → open.
The close/open commands use the existing Robotiq interface and wait for each commanded state before advancing.
Focused no-hardware tests cover the command order.
Operator documentation states that reset releases any held object.
decisions: Every reset, including successful Y completion and A+X discard/reset, closes the gripper before arm motion and opens it after arm motion.
Opening completion is the operator-visible signal that reset is complete and new inputs may be issued.
The reset sequence intentionally releases any held object; it is only appropriate when the workspace permits release.

verification.summary: Release commits 53f57d4 and cfe858d add the configured close → one arm reset trajectory → open sequence, excluding initial startup positioning and removing convergence/open-width waits.
checks: Hydra YAML parse confirmed reset_gripper_signal=true without a reset open-timeout gate
Python compilation and Git diff whitespace checks passed
limitations: No post-change hardware test has run.
Every post-startup reset deliberately releases any held object.
No hardware validation has run for the faster reset sequence or immediate record-start edge.
